Chain-of-Thought outputs and final answers for math word problems

changes_made.explanation: Removed models that were mentioned but not actually evaluated (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct). Added Commonsense Reasoning task based on CommonsenseQA experiments. Normalized task names to be more specific.
Normalized metric names to standard capitalization. Combined 'number of CoT tokens' and 'CoT token count' into single normalized form.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses LLMs for generation but not for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations used automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Chain-of-Thought compression for LLMs, primarily evaluating on mathematical reasoning tasks (GSM8K, MATH-500) with some out-of-domain testing on commonsense reasoning (CommonsenseQA). The extraction was generally accurate but included some models that were mentioned but not evaluated. The paper uses standard automatic metrics but no LLM-as-judge or human evaluation.
